sections.title: Independent finding and successor correction
sections.body: The original independent J1 review found three direct Git card comparisons incorrectly labelled kb and missing verified_by. V3 changes only those provenance fields to retrieved and adds the coordinator, date and exact source binding. Original candidates and the adverse review are preserved.

sections.title: Independent checks and scoped acceptance
sections.body: J1 holds for V3 at c49b7f123d21e4a9c03465f3c56003a3df9917dd. All four effective-source comparisons preserve non-attribution fields. The first candidate is byte-identical to V2; the other three change only the intended nearest entry. Source, prior-candidate and registry bytes remain unchanged.

sections.title: Targeted validation and adversarial controls
sections.body: The real pinned prior-art validator returns four errors before and zero for these four candidates. The original review ran 38 candidate controls and eight registry hash controls. Four false semantic claims deliberately remained schema-green, exposing the validator boundary. The successor passed 21 independent provenance controls; the producer separately passed 18 controls.

sections.title: Source and literature limits
sections.body: The review binds 22 source documents and reads six KR cards. Source base: 7e45528b293fd42049b1486a03135670ab5ac55c. KR-IC-73db3f remains heuristic with abstract-only sources. Reading repository cards does not newly verify their literature or findings. No historical pre-proposal search or approval is invented.

sections.title: Application and delivery remain open
sections.body: Conductor admits only the report directory. Ledger and registry writes remain blocked by existing migration reservations and have not occurred. Full-corpus validation, current route guards and successful current-head CI remain required. This acceptance is limited to candidate attribution fidelity.

sections.title: Scientific and visual boundary
sections.body: No experiment, theorem, attack-cost result, novelty status, approval, seed, threshold or claim is newly established. The diagram shows review and application states; no canonical scientific or performance graph source changed. Exact reviewer outputs, initial failures, handoffs and hashes accompany this report.
